title: Applicability of other provisions of this chapter.
bodyText: Except to the extent that the provisions of this part are inconsistent, all provisions of article 4 shall apply to the share accounts and deposit accounts offered by a credit union. In case of any inconsistencies, the provisions of this part shall control.
bodyHtml:
PART III.  ACCOUNTS

 

     §412:10-300  Applicability of other provisions of this chapter.  Except to the extent that the provisions of this part are inconsistent, all provisions of article 4 shall apply to the share accounts and deposit accounts offered by a credit union.  In case of any inconsistencies, the provisions of this part shall control. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
